info.name: Global search — classes section (tasks 01–03)
info.description: Contract checks for the classes section of POST /api/search, runnable against the prod read-only server (real data) or the local seeded bed. Setup: reference/postman/global-search-classes.README.md. Signed-in requests mint their own JWT with the LOCAL jwt_secret — point {{base}} only at the local test worktree, never at prod.

item.name: Collections — Classes capsule only with SEARCH_CLASSES_CAPSULE_ENABLED

exec: pm.test('200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
const slugs = pm.response.json().data.map((c) => c.slug);
pm.test('all, courses first', () => pm.expect(slugs.slice(0, 2)).to.eql(['all', 'courses']));
pm.test('Classes capsule is either absent (flag off, the default) or right after Courses', () =>
pm.expect(slugs.includes('classes') ? slugs[2] : 'absent').to.be.oneOf(['classes', 'absent']));

item.name: 1. Guest — no token (body userId must never reveal purchases)
Guest · owned query (body userId = the buyer)

exec: const res = pm.response.json();

const d = res.data || {};

const bad = (rule, pred) => { const v = cl.filter((c) => !pred(c)).map((c) => c.id + ' ' + c.title); pm.test('guest owned: ' + rule, () => pm.expect(v, v.join(' | ')).to.eql([])); };
const rank = (x) => (x.isPurchased ? 0 : x.isFree ? 1 : 2);

bad('no duplicate classes', (c) => cl.filter((o) => o.id === c.id).length === 1);
bad('meta never carries Class.isLive or the asset', (c) => !('isLive' in c.meta) && !('hlsAsset' in c.meta));
bad('streamStatus is a known state or null', (c) => [null,"preparing","live","reconnecting","processing","ended"].includes(c.meta.streamStatus));
bad('hasPlayback / canPlay / isFree are booleans', (c) => ['hasPlayback', 'canPlay', 'isFree'].every((k) => typeof c.meta[k] === 'boolean'));
bad('every class has at least one attached course', (c) => Array.isArray(c.meta.courses) && c.meta.courses.length > 0);

bad('every attached course has the full field set', (c) => c.meta.courses.every((x) => ["id","title","imageUrl","deepLink","price","isLive","isRecorded","isActive","isFree","isPurchased","classTitle","startDate","endDate"].every((k) => k in x)));
bad('no course attached twice', (c) => new Set(c.meta.courses.map((x) => x.id)).size === c.meta.courses.length);
bad('an inactive course is attached only when bought', (c) => c.meta.courses.every((x) => x.isActive || x.isPurchased));
bad('canPlay = class free OR any course free/bought', (c) => c.meta.canPlay === (c.meta.isFree || c.meta.courses.some((x) => x.isFree || x.isPurchased)));
bad('courses ordered purchased → free → rest', (c) => c.meta.courses.every((x, i, a) => i === 0 || rank(a[i - 1]) <= rank(x)));
bad('guest view: nothing purchased', (c) => c.meta.courses.every((x) => x.isPurchased === false));
bad('guest view: no inactive course', (c) => c.meta.courses.every((x) => x.isActive === true));
if (cl[0]) pm.collectionVariables.set('first_class_id', cl[0].id);
pm.collectionVariables.set('guest_owned', JSON.stringify(cl.map((c) => c.id + ':' + c.meta.courses.map((x) => x.id + (x.isPurchased ? 'P' : '')).join(','))));

item.name: 2. Signed in — valid token for user_id
Signed in · owned query → purchased course first, canPlay

exec: const b64u = (w) => CryptoJS.enc.Base64.stringify(w).replace(/=+$/, '').replace(/\+/g, '-').replace(/\//g, '_');
const enc = (o) => b64u(CryptoJS.enc.Utf8.parse(JSON.stringify(o)));
const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
const sign = (payload, secret) => { const h = enc({ alg: 'HS256', typ: 'JWT' }); const p = enc(payload);
return h + '.' + p + '.' + b64u(CryptoJS.HmacSHA256(h + '.' + p, secret)); };
const payload = { user_id: pm.variables.get('user_id'), email: 'postman@local', mobile: '0', iat: now - 120,
exp: now + 3600 };
pm.variables.set('token', sign(payload, pm.variables.get('jwt_secret')));
const res = pm.response.json();
pm.test('signed-in owned: 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
